name: 使用 SAP Business Network 的集中采购报价自动化 (5JT)
name_en: Automation of Central Procurement Quote with SAP Business Network (5JT)
description_en_html:
Overview

The SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition Central Procurement offers a centralized RFQ process with a deep integration into the customer's landscape. It connects SAP Business Network to the customer’s SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition system (on-premise). With the SAP Central Procurement, you can pool or aggregate purchase requisitions created in multiple connected backend systems to create a single central RFQ and thus get support for better scale pricing. SAP Business Network provides access to more than two million companies who can provide quotations and quick and easy supplier discovery. Once the award process is completed in SAP Central Procurement, the supplier quotation generates either purchase orders or contracts in the respective connected backend system.

Key Process Flow

  • Create a central RFQ in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition Central Procurement System for purchase requisitions that are created in the connected backend systems (central purchaser)
  • Send the central RFQ to the SAP Ariba Discovery application, where suppliers can submit quotations
  • Award one or more central supplier quotations in SAP SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition Central Procurement System (central purchaser)
  • Use central supplier quotation to create operational purchase orders in the respective connected backend ERP systems or central contracts in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition Central Procurement System which creates operational purchasing contracts in the respective connected systems.

Business Benefits

  • Aggregate demand by pooling requisitions created in multiple connected backend systems into one central RFQ
  • Source the best supplier based on the aggregated demand, using the power of SAP Ariba Discovery
  • Quick turnaround time to get the prices from suppliers
  • Seamless creation of purchase orders and contracts in the respective backend systems upon finalization of the Award process in SAP Central Procurement
  • Digital collaboration with suppliers reducing manual processing steps
description_zh_html:
概览

SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 集中采购提供了一个集中 RFQ 流程，该流程深度集成到客户的架构中。它将 SAP Business Network 连接到客户的 SAP ERP 或 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 系统（企业预置）。通过 SAP Central Procurement，您可以池或汇总在多个连接的后端系统中创建的采购申请，以创建单个集中 RFQ，从而获得更好的规模定价支持。SAP Business Network 提供对超过 200 万家公司的访问，这些公司可以提供报价并快速轻松地发现供应商。在 SAP Central Procurement 中完成授标流程后，供应商报价会在相应的已连接后端系统中生成采购订单或合同。

关键流程流

  • 在 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 集中采购系统中为在连接的后端系统（集中采购员）中创建的采购申请创建集中 RFQ
  • 将集中 RFQ 发送到 SAP Ariba Discovery 应用程序，供应商可以在其中提交报价
  • 在 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 集中采购系统（集中采购员）中授标一个或多个集中供应商报价
  • 在 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 集中采购系统中，使用集中供应商报价在相应连接的后端 ERP 系统或集中合同中创建运营采购订单，以便在相应的已连接系统中创建运营采购合同。

业务优势

  • 通过将在多个连接的后端系统中创建的申请集中到一个集中 RFQ 中来聚合需求
  • 利用 SAP Ariba Discovery 的强大功能，根据聚合需求寻找最佳供应商
  • 快速周转时间从供应商处获取价格
  • 在 SAP Central Procurement 中完成授标流程后，在相应后端系统中无缝创建采购订单和合同
  • 与供应商开展数字化协作，减少手动处理步骤
